metadata.title: Parallel burn-in: two code-runner tasks on same repo
metadata.goal: Fix calculator AND formatter in parallel via worktrees

tasks.title: Fix calculator bugs
tasks.prompt: Fix all bugs in src/calculator.py: 1. add() subtracts instead of adding — change return a - b to return a + b 2. subtract() adds instead of subtracting — change return a + b to return a - b 3. divide() has no zero check — add: if b == 0: raise ValueError("Cannot divide by zero")

tasks.title: Fix formatter bugs
tasks.prompt: Fix all bugs in src/formatter.py: 1. format_name() returns "last first" — swap to return f"{first} {last}" 2. format_currency() needs comma thousands and 2 decimal places: return f"{symbol}{amount:,.2f}" 3. format_list() uses str() — change to: return ", ".join(items) if items else "" Also: replace 'import logging' with 'from loguru import logger'.
